name: page-models-tab
goal: Pages show a Models tab instead of Contract, with revision-bound data models reached through page dependencies

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Pages replace Contract with Models; show distinct active models through components and services at the selected revision; preserve model links and non-page contracts; cover historical empty states and three viewports. Existing coverage asserted Contract on every visual page and never traversed nested model dependencies.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Replaced the Page Contract tab with Models, added revision-bound transitive model discovery, reused catalog cards with consumer lists omitted in this context, and canonicalized legacy Page Contract links to Models. Existing model links and other entity contracts are preserved.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Red: existing relations assertions and all three browser viewport cases failed on Contract and missing nested model data. Green: 61 route tests, full Reports unit suite, and all 10 affected browser tests pass; tests cover nested models, cycles, duplicates, unrelated and inactive models, revision scope, empty history, and model navigation. Manually exercised seven actual models and View More in the in-app browser.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Revision-bound Models, type-collection exclusions and shared cards pass the matched final corpus. Reports check 668 tests and allowed root checks pass. Final capture readback and remote main provenance are landing gates. Full CLI/native suites remain deferred.
